description: This file defines the TileLayer class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending GridLayer to load and display map tiles with configurable options such as zoom levels, subdomains, retina detection, and URL templates.

classes.name: TileLayer
classes.description: A class extending GridLayer used to load and display map tiles with various configurable options.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Updates the URL template for the tile layer and optionally redraws the layer.

methods.name: createTile
methods.description: Creates an HTML image element for a tile at given coordinates, setting event handlers and source URL.

methods.name: getTileUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for a tile based on its coordinates, considering options like TMS and retina display.

methods.name: _tileOnLoad
methods.description: Handles the load event for a tile, calling the done callback.

methods.name: _tileOnError
methods.description: Handles errors during tile loading, replacing the tile source with an error tile if specified.

methods.name: _onTileRemove
methods.description: Removes the onload event handler from a tile when it is unloaded.

methods.name: _getZoomForUrl
methods.description: Calculates the zoom level to be used in tile URL based on options like zoomReverse and zoomOffset.

methods.name: _getSubdomain
methods.description: Selects a subdomain for tile URL based on tile coordinates.

methods.name: _abortLoading
methods.description: Stops loading all tiles in the background layer.

methods.name: _removeTile
methods.description: Removes a tile from the layer, cancelling requests and cleaning up.

methods.name: _tileReady
methods.description: Handles the completion of tile loading, ensuring the map and tile are valid.
